collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A friend asks a villager why they never take one path in the village, and they cannot remember.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There's one path in the village that (subject) never takes. The one past the old fallen tree. (subject.He/She) always goes the other way. (subject.He/She) has done it for so long (subject.he/she) doesn't even think about it anymore. Today (friend) asks why, and (subject) realizes (subject.he/she) has completely forgotten.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) walks down the forbidden path, slowly, looking around at everything. It's a perfectly ordinary path. There's a nice view of the sea. (subject.He/She) gets to the end and nothing happens at all. On the way back, (subject.he/she) suddenly remembers: a crab pinched (subject.him/her) there, when (subject.he/she) was about four. (subject.He/She) laughs all the way home.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "I don't know why," says (subject). "I just don't." (friend) shrugs. That's fine. Everyone's allowed one path they don't take. (subject) goes the long way round, as always. It occurs to (subject.him/her) that it doesn't really matter why. It's just how (subject.he/she) goes.
